values.binNote: Bin stores per-second rates (BasePercentMaxHPDmgPerSec=[0.04,0.06,0.08], ADRatioPerSecond=1.375); the wiki's per-tick numbers equal those rates multiplied by SecondsPerTick=0.25 (0.04*0.25=0.01, 1.375*0.25=0.34375), matching the tick-rate the wiki quotes as '.../8'.

values.meaning: Total Physical Damage per full cast (8 ticks, i.e. one 2-second spin)
values.binNote: This is a derived per-cast total, not a distinct bin row. #DamagePerSecondTotal (ADRatioPerSecond=1.375 x ad) and #{26c20668} (BasePercentMaxHPDmgPerSec=[0.04,0.06,0.08]) are explicitly per-second rates; multiplying each by SpinDuration=2 (the length of one 2-second spin, matching r_4) gives the wiki's per-cast totals: 0.04*2=0.08 ... 0.08*2=0.16 for the max-HP term, and 1.375*2=2.75 for the AD term. The bin's own #TotalDamageTT/#PercentHPDamageTT calculations perform this same multiplication but are marked tooltip-only, so this value restates their math using the underlying per-second rows instead.

deals {{as|physical damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to enemies hit

mechanics.claim: Cyclone deals damage as repeated periodic ticks against every enemy hit, each tick a separate damage instance.
mechanics.quote: The staff deals {{as|physical damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to enemies hit

mechanics.claim: Cyclone recasts automatically after the first cast ends (or on another ability cast), effectively doubling total duration/damage if allowed to continue.
mechanics.quote: does so automatically afterwards or by casting another {{tip|ability}}

mechanics.claim: Casting a basic ability always interrupts Cyclone, cutting its damage window short.
mechanics.quote: Casting a basic ability will always interrupt '''Wukong's''' ''Cyclone''.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield blocks one instance (one tick) of Cyclone's damage.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block one instance of damage.

mechanics.claim: Cyclone's damage against monsters is capped per second, but this does not apply against champions.
mechanics.quote: ''Cyclone's'' damage is capped at {{pp|200 to 600 for 3|6;11;16}} per second against {{tip|monsters}}.
